about: Thirty skeletons of calls about a job already in the shop or just finished: ten kinds, three each. Rubric type existing_job: greeting and recap are the only checks (recap when something is agreed). Advisor lines are tiered by the advisor's tier (exact, warm, curt) and take the advisor's tokens; customer lines take the voice's opener, filler and tail. {tech_name} is never slot 11 in a complaint or comeback.
